title: Concept: npm client configured to write no lockfile
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that stops the lockfile being written or honoured, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every install resolves fresh from the registry, so two builds of the same commit can compile different code and no integrity value is recorded.
risk: Every install resolves fresh from the registry, so two builds of the same commit can compile different code and no integrity value is recorded.
